blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.6
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.6

blocks.text: शक्तिचक्रसन्धाने विश्वसंहारः
blocks.directed: [slowly] शक्तिचक्रसन्धाने विश्वसंहारः

blocks.text: Śakticakrasandhāne viśvasaṃhāraḥ.
blocks.directed: Śakticakrasandhāne viśvasaṃhāraḥ.

blocks.text: Through union with the circle of powers, the universe is withdrawn.
blocks.directed: Through union with the circle of powers, the universe is withdrawn.

blocks.text: The Universe Gets Swallowed, but Don’t Worry About the Furniture.
blocks.directed: The Universe Gets Swallowed, but Don’t Worry About the Furniture.

blocks.text: Right.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Right.

blocks.text: Now we’re dissolving universes.
blocks.directed: Now we’re dissolving universes.

blocks.text: Six statements in.
blocks.directed: Six statements in.

blocks.text: Excellent pace.
blocks.directed: Excellent pace.

blocks.text: Śakti is power.
blocks.directed: Śakti is power.

blocks.text: Cakra is a wheel, circle, or collective.
blocks.directed: Cakra is a wheel, circle, or collective.

blocks.text: Sandhāna means joining, connecting, or bringing into union.
blocks.directed: Sandhāna means joining, connecting, or bringing into union.

blocks.text: Viśvasaṃhāra is the withdrawal or dissolution of the universe.
blocks.directed: Viśvasaṃhāra is the withdrawal or dissolution of the universe.

blocks.text: But we’re not saying the advanced yogi sits in his bedroom and Jupiter physically disappears.
blocks.directed: But we’re not saying the advanced yogi sits in his bedroom and Jupiter physically disappears.

blocks.text: Rather, Kṣemarāja is explaining the withdrawal of differentiated manifestation into its conscious source.
blocks.directed: Rather, Kṣemarāja is explaining the withdrawal of differentiated manifestation into its conscious source.

blocks.text: Consider all the powers constituting your experience.
blocks.directed: Consider all the powers constituting your experience.

blocks.text: Seeing.
blocks.directed: Seeing.

blocks.text: Hearing.
blocks.directed: Hearing.

blocks.text: Thinking.
blocks.directed: Thinking.

blocks.text: Remembering.
blocks.directed: Remembering.

blocks.text: Imagining.
blocks.directed: Imagining.

blocks.text: Desiring.
blocks.directed: Desiring.

blocks.text: Each appears as a distinct activity.
blocks.directed: Each appears as a distinct activity.

blocks.text: Ordinarily, attention follows these activities outward, towards their objects.
blocks.directed: Ordinarily, attention follows these activities outward, towards their objects.

blocks.text: But what happens when consciousness recognises the shared reality of these powers?
blocks.directed: But what happens when consciousness recognises the shared reality of these powers?

blocks.text: The apparent separateness of their manifestations is reabsorbed into the unity from which they arise.
blocks.directed: The apparent separateness of their manifestations is reabsorbed into the unity from which they arise.

blocks.text: The universe is no longer experienced as something independent of the conscious reality manifesting it.
blocks.directed: The universe is no longer experienced as something independent of the conscious reality manifesting it.

blocks.text: This is saṃhāra — withdrawal.
blocks.directed: This is saṃhāra — withdrawal.

blocks.text: And it’s inseparable from manifestation.
blocks.directed: And it’s inseparable from manifestation.

blocks.text: Śiva expresses the universe through Śakti.
blocks.directed: Śiva expresses the universe through Śakti.

blocks.text: Śiva withdraws the universe through Śakti.
blocks.directed: Śiva withdraws the universe through Śakti.

blocks.text: It’s not a one-way escape from a terrible material world.
blocks.directed: It’s not a one-way escape from a terrible material world.

blocks.text: It’s a dynamic movement of manifestation and reabsorption within consciousness itself.
blocks.directed: It’s a dynamic movement of manifestation and reabsorption within consciousness itself.

blocks.text: Like a wave discovering that it was never separate from the ocean.
blocks.directed: Like a wave discovering that it was never separate from the ocean.

blocks.text: Except the ocean is conscious, infinitely free, and has been pretending to be every single wave.
blocks.directed: Except the ocean is conscious, infinitely free, and has been pretending to be every single wave.

blocks.text: Which is quite the hobby.
blocks.directed: Which is quite the hobby.
